title: Split acre into a library, a CLI and a GUI crate
body: acre is one package today: the `acre` library and the `acre` binary share `Cargo.toml`, so a program that depends on the library compiles `clap` and `anyhow`, and would compile the GUI toolkit too. Jack chose a virtual workspace under `crates/`: `acre` the library, `acre-cli` with the `acre` binary for check and render, and `acre-gui` with the `acre-gui` binary. Each crate keeps its own version and changelog.
